claim: JWST detected carbon dioxide in WASP-39b's atmosphere.
The CO2 absorption feature was detected at 4.3 micrometres.
The carbon dioxide absorption feature had a significance of 26 sigma.
JWST detected methane instead of carbon dioxide in WASP-39b's atmosphere.
WASP-39b has an atmospheric temperature of exactly 500 K.
The observations covered wavelengths from 3.0 to 5.5 micrometres.
The carbon dioxide absorption feature was observed at 8.6 micrometres.
